active_listing_count.definition: Average number of listings in active for-sale status on a typical day during the month, excluding pending listings where pending status is available.
active_listing_count.label: Active listings

new_listing_count.definition: Number of listings newly added to the market during the month. Year-over-year comparison is emphasized because listing activity is seasonal.
new_listing_count.label: New listings

pending_ratio.definition: Pending listing count divided by active listing count for the ZIP code during the month. Availability depends on consistent pending-status reporting.
pending_ratio.label: Pending-to-active ratio
